methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly for each vendor. Several pages (headshotpro.com/pricing, aragon.ai/pricing, betterpic.io/pricing, tryitonai.com/pricing) render prices client-side and returned no dollar amounts in HTML; for these, figures were corroborated against multiple 2026 third-party reviews and the official FAQ/compare pages, and only consistently-reported figures were retained. Photo AI (subscription) and Dreamwave returned full prices directly; Secta returned its single $49 tier directly. Pack-based one-time purchases are modelled as monthlyUsd equal to the pack price with billingModel 'flat' and a note clarifying the one-time nature. Where a tier is contact-sales / enterprise with no published price, monthlyUsd is null. Where third-party sources conflicted irreconcilably (Try It On AI), disputed prices were set to null rather than guessed. Compliance flags are true only where a verifiable official trust/security statement exists; otherwise null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

Team $39/person with 20% off for groups of 5+ confirmed. Money-back ('Profile-Worthy') guarantee confirmed but no fixed 14-day window is stated by the vendor (removed). SOC2 inferred from on-page Oneleet security badge; GDPR implied (Holland-based) but not formally certified, left null.
